Package chess.model

Class Board

java.lang.Object
chess.model.Board
public class Board extends Object
The 8 × 8 chess board, stored as a grid of pieces, plus a record of every piece that has been captured.

Each cell holds a Piece or null for an empty square. Cells are indexed with Position.getRow() and Position.getCol(), so grid[0][0] is A8 and grid[7][7] is H1.

The board stores pieces and carries out moves, but it does not decide whether a move is legal. Game checks the rules first and only then calls movePiece(Position, Position).

    • isPathClear

      public boolean isPathClear(Position from, Position to)
      Checks whether every square strictly between two squares is empty. This only applies to straight or diagonal lines; for any other pair of squares (such as a knight's jump) there is nothing in between, so it returns true.
      Parameters:
      from - the starting square
      to - the ending square
      Returns:
      true if nothing blocks the line between them

    • movePiece

      public Piece movePiece(Position from, Position to)
      Moves the piece on one square to another. If an enemy piece is on the destination, it is removed and added to the captured list.

      This method does not check the rules. Call it only after the move has been validated.

      Parameters:
      from - the square the piece moves from
      to - the square the piece moves to
      Returns:
      the captured piece, or null if nothing was captured
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if there is no piece on from
